extraction_notes: Digitised SI performance figures only: SI Figures S1, S2, S4 and S13. SI Figure S3 was skipped because it is for reaction-order/kinetic analysis, and SI Figures S5–S12 were characterisation/DFT rather than measured NH3 synthesis performance. Values are approximate readings from plotted markers/bars. SI Figure S4 caption appears to list a fixed pressure of 1.0 MPa despite pressure being the x-axis; records use the plotted pressure values.
